QuestInfo.name: Pixies' Cloud Pieces
QuestInfo.1: Spiruna had discovered the cause of Orbis's sinking. The Pixies have been absorbing the magic from the enchanted clouds that hold it afloat. Now the #o3230200#, #o4230106#, and #o5120000# monsters have taken #b20 of the #t4031309##k items needed for maintenance!
QuestInfo.2: Just as #p2032001# requested, you gathered up 20 #t4031309# items from the Pixies and gave them to her. But to whom does this #bnecklace chain#k belong?

0.0: Hmm... I think we found the cause. Orbis can only float thanks to our special #bmagical clouds#k. Of course, now those annoying Pixies are absorbing all the magical energy for themselves, and our clouds can't hold us up.
0.1: We need to hurry and recover the #b#t04031309##k the Pixies took, then fix everything up. Can you help me one more time?

yes.0: We need Cloud Pieces to fix up the clouds that hold Orbis up, but the Pixies have been taking them! Recover around #b20 Cloud Pieces#k from the Pixies in Orbis. I bet those greedy Luster Pixies took most of them...\r\n

no.0: It seems like you just want Orbis to fall down...

1.0: You brought the #b#t4031309##k. That ought to be enough to keep Orbis from sinking. Thank you very much.
1.1: ...Huh? You got that #b#t4037254##k from the Pixies? Well, I don't know who it might belong to. Doesn't surprise me, though, the Pixies stealing everything in sight. Here, I can hold onto it for now.

yes.0: Oh, and take this. It's to show my appreciation.

item.0: We need #b20 #t4031309##k items to get maintenance back on track! I think. I don't really know much about maintenance.
